name: 陳生明
objective: Electrochemical analysis can provide more advanced information, including biochemical reactions, morphology, as well as properties related to physics, chemistry, and electricity. Utilizing relevant technical methods, such as electrochemical tools, can be used to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, as well as to obtain chemical activity and spectra among various interfaces for the development of microdevices. For biological analysis, electrochemical biosensors exhibit the highest reproducibility and can be successfully applied to electroactive biochemical species, matrix materials, and their specifications. Bioelectroanalytical methods include the most advanced and useful techniques, most of which are built on the foundation of this field.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Course Introduction
Week 2: CV (Cyclic Voltammetry): Theory & Examples, Reversible, Irreversible, Quasi-Reversible Systems
Week 3: Scanning Probe Microscopy & Electrochemistry, SEM, STM & Electrochemistry
Week 4: AC Voltammetry, AC Impedance, EIS
Week 5: ISE & Potentiometry Sensors & pH Sensors
Week 6: Bulk Electrolysis, Controlled-Current Techniques
Week 7: Chemically Modified Electrodes and Applications
Week 8: Spectroelectrochemistry and Other Coupled Characterization Methods
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10: RDE (Rotating Disk and Ring-Disk Electrodes): Principle and Applications
Week 11: Polarography and Applications
Week 12: Oxygen Electrochemistry and Oxygen Removal
Week 13: Analytical Chemistry System by Electroanalytical Methods
Week 14: Photoelectrochemistry and Electroanalytical Application
Week 15: (No information provided)
Week 16: Liquid/Liquid Interfaces, Solid/Liquid Interfaces
Week 17: Analytical Applications of Electroactive Polymers
Week 18: Final Exam
